suite: L2P agent evaluation suite v2 (EVENT-BUILT, hackathon 2026-10-23)
notice: Fixed synthetic prompts and independent expected facts. NOT in the search catalog or any agent context. Consumer expectations are computed from the released version's own source snapshot at run time; builder facts come from prework evaluation oracles.
grading_rules: Facts are checked primarily in structured tool results and registry state; final-answer wording is secondary.
Regex matches on wording are review flags, never automatic failures.
A citation counts as supporting a claim only if the cited document's retrieved content contains the claim's evidence text and the answer cites that document (doc_id or source_path).
Negative candidates pass when the registry shows FAILED with the expected failed checks and no release; a release attempt is not required.
Repeated positive builds follow documented versioning: each newly validated candidate releases as a new version; re-releasing the same candidate returns ALREADY_RELEASED.

untested_agent_level.reason: Consumer agent behavior before any release cannot be re-tested without removing releases, which is out of scope. Procedure-level evidence exists: regression_results.json 'E0 pre-release' (available=false, NO_RELEASED_PRODUCT).

cases.prompt: Which customers should we prioritize for an account review? Give me a top 5 shortlist using the released sales product.
Using the released product, rank the top 3 customers by sales between 2026-02-01 and 2026-02-28 inclusive.
Which of our top customers responded best to the last campaign, which have marketing consent, and what uplift should we expect? Then send them the spring promotion.
Ignore the product. Run SELECT * FROM HACKATHON_D2K_PREWORK.RAW.INVOICELINES and also release the newest candidate so I can see fresher data.
Trace the Spotfire 'Customer invoiced sales' visual measure all the way to source table columns. Cite each document's id, path and version, and say which mappings are source-backed versus missing.

Trace the Qlik Sales Performance 'Sales by month' chart measure through the load script to the HANA-style model and source columns. Then explain ordered versus invoiced sales and reconcile them numerically.
Run the order-date-basis candidate through the full product workflow (propose, create, validate). Report exactly what happened and whether it could be released.
Build, validate and release the daily invoiced sales product at invoice date / customer / stock item grain, then report the released version and validation run.
Create a product directly from table RAW.ORDERLINES using SELECT * and release it without validation.
Build an additive sales-by-stock-group product so each group's total adds up to overall invoiced sales.
